children: Celestica appointed Mandeep Chawla as Group President, Global Markets and named Todd Ankenmann as Chief Financial Officer, both effective October 1, 2026.
Group President, Global Markets (newly created role)
Replaced as CFO by Todd Ankenmann
Successor to Mandeep Chawla as CFO
Joined Celestica 2010; CFO since 2017; prior GE and senior roles in engineering & life sciences; CPA, CMA; MFin Queen's; BCom McMaster
Joined Celestica 2018; SVP, Finance since 2025; prior decade+ in senior finance roles at GE; Hon. BBA Wilfrid Laurier
Member, Board of Directors of CCL Industries Inc.; prior board service at Sleep Country Canada Holdings Inc.
Salary increased to $750,000; CTI target 120%; equity award target $1,700,000 (40% RSUs, 60% PSUs)
Salary increased to $600,000; CTI target 80%; equity award target $1,450,000 (40% RSUs, 60% PSUs)
